target_customer: B2B sales, RevOps and growth teams that build prospect lists and enrich leads
problem: Finding the right prospects and enriching them takes stitched-together vendors and manual work. Orange Slice offers a spreadsheet where AI writes TypeScript columns that pull from many data vendors, plus sequencing and signals.
business_model: Usage-based credits, free to start per the company site
product_category: Sales data enrichment and GTM agent platform

founders.name: Vihaar Nandigala
education: University of Michigan (per the YC launch post; degree not stated)
previous_startups: Sold a previous company at 19 (unnamed, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: met co-founder as sophomores on a Bollywood dance team at Michigan.

founders.name: Kishan Sripada
education: University of Michigan (per the YC launch post; degree not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Kishan without surname; surname from a YesPress profile. Leads technical work per that profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating data vendors via waterfall enrichment and an LLM code-generating spreadsheet is integration work with moderate engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Data comes from third-party vendors and the category has many tools (Clay, Apollo, Derrick), so copying is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Clay raised a $100M Series C at a $3.1B valuation in August 2025 per a comparison page, so a well-funded player held the wedge when Orange Slice launched.

market_need_then: Sales teams were already spending on enrichment tools like Clay. The company site claims over 1,000 companies and 9.5M paid lookups (self-reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses orangeslice.ai; acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Cut-paper illustrations and an orange-slice motif per the company site

branding.brand_signature: Orange slice motif with cut-paper illustrations
branding.community_and_virality: Ranked number one Product of the Day on Product Hunt on April 27, 2026 with about 460 upvotes; a founder post says an earlier launch had failed.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly name and a consistent illustrated look, plus a Product Hunt win, but no evidence the brand itself drives growth.

outcome_analysis: Orange Slice is active and says it raised a $5.3M seed after YC, with Product Hunt and usage claims on its site. No exit, shutdown or layoffs found. It competes against much larger, well-funded Clay and Apollo, so durable advantage is unproven.
